author: Brian Stansberry
source_description:
A railroad beam along the Middle Prong Trail, in the Great Smoky Mountains National Park of East Tennessee — located in the Southeastern United States.  
A few such stray beams, ties, and skidder cables are all that remain of the Little River Railroad in Tremont.
The railroad aided logging operations in the area 1926-1938.

author: Ashley Dace
source_description:
Old Railway Sleeper An old sleeper rotting away. Still in its original position possibly from 1879. The Southwold narrow gauge railway ran through here along the marshes connecting Halesworth and Southwold. 
The line closed in 1929 with lifting taking place during the war. Several sleepers can be seen along this section.
